objective: Create the safe PC cleanup audit package. This is design and inventory tooling only: no deletion, no local execution, no paid services. Define a structured audit schema, a discovery procedure, a read-only PowerShell inventory script that can later be run manually on Windows, and an Astra review packet. Update project memory/provenance. The audit script must never delete, uninstall, modify registry, stop services, or alter files.
constraints: No AI video inference on local PC
No cleanup deletion or uninstall actions
PowerShell script must be read-only and output an inventory report only
acceptance_criteria: Existing OutputPath collision fails clearly and leaves the existing file byte-for-byte unchanged.
A brand-new OutputPath succeeds using create-new semantics; default stdout creates no report file.
.github, .gitignore, active control files/directories, current triggers, and arbitrary worker_result_TASK-*.json are KEEP_ACTIVE when candidate roots overlap the project.
AgentOwnedCandidateRoots serializes as [] for zero roots, a one-element array for one root, and an array for many roots.
Duplicate/overlapping roots emit each normalized absolute file exactly once and summary counts equal unique item count.
Missing and file-valued supplied roots cannot produce an apparently successful complete audit; enumeration errors are surfaced.
PowerShell 7+ is enforced before unsupported APIs; Windows PowerShell 5.1 fails immediately with a clear PowerShell 7 prerequisite message.
Reports produced by zero-, one-, and multi-root fixtures validate against schemas/pc_cleanup_audit.schema.json.
provenance_match means exact normalized absolute provenance membership only.
Documentation matches conservative external-root behavior and runtime requirement.
Astra packet remains PENDING_ASTRA_REVIEW and contains commands/runtime expectations/known limitations/all seven artifacts without fabricating test results.
retry_reason: GPT-6 Astra final review #1 rejected the candidate with six reproduced defects. Apply Astra's correction package exactly; do not widen cleanup permissions.
orchestrator_corrections: Implement Astra review #1 exactly. Do not delete, uninstall, modify registry, stop services, kill processes, remove packages, or alter candidate files.

Support an optional OutputPath, but never overwrite. Use literal-path-safe atomic CREATE-NEW behavior so an existing destination fails before content can be changed. Default behavior remains stdout only.

Protect the entire active orchestrator tree before candidate classification. At minimum protect .git, .github, memory, tasks, docs, triggers, review_packets, schemas, scripts, README.md, AGENTS.md, GEMINI.md, .gitignore, PROVENANCE_REGISTRY.jsonl, all workflow files, and any worker_result_*.json present under ActiveProjectRoot.
KEEP_ACTIVE precedence applies even when AgentOwnedCandidateRoots overlaps ActiveProjectRoot.
AgentOwnedCandidateRoots must serialize as JSON arrays for 0, 1, and N values. Preserve array shape explicitly.
Deduplicate candidate files by normalized absolute path using a case-insensitive HashSet/Dictionary before adding report entries.

Validate ActiveProjectRoot and every AgentOwnedCandidateRoot before scanning: each must exist and be a directory. Missing roots and file-valued roots must fail clearly. Enumeration exceptions must not be silently suppressed; fail the audit or report explicit incomplete status/errors.
Require PowerShell 7 or later at the top of the script, before calling APIs unavailable in Windows PowerShell 5.1. Error message must explicitly say PowerShell 7 is required.
Keep provenance_match semantics exact normalized absolute path only. No filename-only matching.
Conservative external-root fallback to UNVERIFIED_DO_NOT_REMOVE is acceptable and preferred if no exact provenance match; documentation must say this consistently.

Update the Astra review packet with exact regression commands to be run by the repository CI gate, supported runtime requirement, known limitations, and all seven candidate artifacts. Leave actual CI result fields pending until the CI run completes; do not fabricate PASS.
Use exact model gemini-3.5-flash-lite in every new provenance-bearing filename and metadata record for this revision.
